intake_analysis.case_summary: Amber Bell and Erik Devlin entered into a contract with LLW Construction, led by Mike Winiarek, for home renovations totaling $128,335.77. They have made multiple payments totaling $100,000 but have encountered significant issues with the quality and completeness of the work. Despite ongoing communication attempts, the contractor has been unresponsive. The clients have incurred additional costs and are facing potential liens from subcontractors. They seek financial recovery for the payments made and compensation for further expenses to complete the project.
desired_outcomes: Reimbursement of payments made for incomplete or substandard work (~$100,000).
Compensation for additional costs incurred to correct or complete the work.
key_facts: Total payments made to date are $100,000.
Multiple issues with work quality noted since December 2024.
Received notice to owner/contractor with lien verbiage.
